description: Structural superposition of Abitram AlphaFold model onto GcvH crystal structures: RMSD and TM-score
code:
import requests, json, time, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
meta=S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q80ZQ9',timeout=90).json()[0]
qpdb=S.get(meta['pdbUrl'],timeout=90).text
rr=S.post('https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket',files={'q':('q.pdb',qpdb)},
          data=[('mode','3diaa'),('database[]','pdb100')],timeout=180)
tid=rr.json()['id']
for k in range(90):
    st=S.get(f'https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket/{tid}',timeout=60).json()
    if st.get('status') in ('COMPLETE','ERROR'): break
    time.sleep(4)
als=S.get(f'https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/{tid}/0',timeout=180).json()['results'][0]['alignments']
if als and isinstance(als[0],list): als=[x for s_ in als for x in s_]

# query CA coords
qCA={}; qplddt={}
for l in qpdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        qCA[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
        qplddt[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])

def kabsch(P,Q):
    Pc,Qc=P-P.mean(0),Q-Q.mean(0)
    V,Sv,W=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W))
    D=np.diag([1,1,d]); R=V@D@W
    return Pc@R, Qc

def tmscore(P,Q,Lref):
    d0=1.24*(Lref-15)**(1/3)-1.8 if Lref>15 else 0.5
    d0=max(d0,0.5)
    best=0
    n=len(P)
    for L in [n, max(4,n//2), max(4,n//4), 4]:
        for s in range(0, n-L+1, max(1,L//2)):
            sub=slice(s,s+L)
            # iterative extension
            idx=np.arange(s,s+L)
            for it in range(20):
                A,B=kabsch(P[idx],Q[idx])
                # apply same transform to all
                Pc=P-P[idx].mean(0); Qc=Q-Q[idx].mean(0)
                V,Sv,W=np.linalg.svd((P[idx]-P[idx].mean(0)).T@(Q[idx]-Q[idx].mean(0)))
                dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,dd])@W
                Pr=Pc@R
                dist=np.linalg.norm(Pr-Qc,axis=1)
                score=np.sum(1/(1+(dist/d0)**2))/Lref
                best=max(best,score)
                cut=d0+1.0
                newidx=np.where(dist<max(cut,3.5))[0]
                if len(newidx)<4 or (len(newidx)==len(idx) and np.all(newidx==idx)): break
                idx=newidx
    return best

rows=[]
for a in als[:8]:
    tca=np.array([float(x) for x in a['tCa'].split(',')])
    n=len(tca)//3
    T=np.stack([tca[:n],tca[n:2*n],tca[2*n:]],axis=1)  # foldseek: x..,y..,z..
    qa,ta=a['qAln'],a['dbAln']
    qi=a['qStartPos']; ti=0   # tCa covers aligned target region starting at dbStartPos
    P=[];Q=[]
    for cq,ct in zip(qa,ta):
        if cq!='-' and ct!='-':
            if qi in qCA and ti<n: P.append(qCA[qi]); Q.append(T[ti])
        if cq!='-': qi+=1
        if ct!='-': ti+=1
    P=np.array(P); Q=np.array(Q)
    A,B=kabsch(P,Q)
    rmsd=np.sqrt(((A-B)**2).sum(1).mean())
    tm=tmscore(P,Q,Lref=min(a['qLen'],a['dbLen']))
    rows.append(dict(target=a['target'].split('-assembly')[0].upper(), tax=a['taxName'],
                     evalue=a['eval'], npairs=len(P), rmsd=rmsd, tm=tm, seqid=a['seqId']))
    print("%-7s %-28s E=%-9.1g pairs=%-4d RMSD=%.2f A  TM=%.3f  seqid=%.1f%%"%(
        rows[-1]['target'], rows[-1]['tax'][:28], a['eval'], len(P), rmsd, tm, a['seqId']))

import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); print("\n",df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nmedian TM-score to GcvH structures: %.3f"%df.tm.median())

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
ax[0].barh(df.target, df.tm, color='#4C78A8')
ax[0].axvline(0.5, ls='--', c='#E45756'); ax[0].text(0.51,0.2,'TM 0.5\nsame fold',color='#E45756',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel('TM-score vs mouse Abitram AF model'); ax[0].set_title('Abitram superposes on glycine cleavage H protein')
ax[1].scatter(df.seqid, df.rmsd, s=60, color='#F58518')
for _,r in df.iterrows(): ax[1].annotate(r.target,(r.seqid,r.rmsd),fontsize=7,xytext=(3,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax[1].set_xlabel('sequence identity over structural alignment (%)'); ax[1].set_ylabel('CA RMSD (A)')
ax[1].set_title('Twilight-zone sequence identity, conserved fold')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
